improvements: Refreshed the irregular ten-level building outline.
Changed ribbon glazing to continuous glass bands without automatic wall piers.

A weathered grey-beige slab with continuous ribbon windows and pale sill bands over a dark shop floor, and a taller, almost blind pale tower with one vertical glazed strip at the NORTH end (the model had it at the south end).
The red PATRIA marquee and vertical sign are removed: no such sign shows on the Bd. Magheru front in the panoramas.
remainingGaps: Ten source levels are mapped, but the 41 m crown, band spacing and tower step profile remain estimated.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.
OSM w163622261 gives 10 levels (33 m at 3.3 m); the tower height of 43 m is an estimate, it has no part of its own.
